name: French Guiana
summary_text: French Guiana: full French law applies; but strong religious-conservative norms, high violent crime, few LGBT services. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: France (0.67) plus a local delta of -0.06. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: The Plight Of Trans Women In Prison
sources.claim_summary: BuzzFeed News feature (Jan 2018, French context): trans women in France incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant to French Guiana as a French overseas region applying French law.

CGLPL opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (French context, applicable in French Guiana): serious violations persist across places of detention.

sources.title: Transgender rights in French Guiana — Grokipedia
sources.claim_summary: Grokipedia page on transgender rights in French Guiana: France's national framework applies - simplified legal gender recognition since 2017 (administrative declaration, no surgery/sterilisation/diagnosis required), anti-discrimination protections since 2012, hate-crime provisions 2017; but specialised trans healthcare is limited by remoteness; societal transphobia and cultural taboos discourage visibility and reporting.
